caseName: Rapides Parish Police Jury v. Bradas
caseNameFull: Rapides Parish Police Jury v. John Bradas

opinions.text:
Application for stay of judgment of the United States District Court for the Western District of Louisiana pending appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, presented to Mr. Justice Powell and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
